central_verdict: The strict functional-calculus class cannot generate the fine U(12) gauge: the projection layer remains irreducibly additional in that class. The fold certificate can now discover its own local center, exact noisy recovery and finite-dependence count laws are available, and a matched-gap bath qubit realizes thermalization of one selected transition.
